title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. pachyphylla
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. pachyphylla, commonly known as Kidney Vetch or Pachyphylla Kidney Vetch, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat kidney and urinary issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Kidney Vetch include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
